scope: Exact synthetic linear-algebra control only. These values are not a computed EGB response matrix or physical covariance.
covariance_semantics: This is the covariance of the predicted-output difference, including shared model/numerical error. It is supplied directly as a synthetic known-truth control; it is not inferred from two independent scalar standard deviations.
assertions: Adding x3 must not change the covariance-aware Mahalanobis score.
Treating x1, x2 and x3 as independent spuriously increases the squared score from 5 to 8.
The selector must detect or explicitly classify the singular covariance support; no silent regularization is permitted.
The covariance must transform with the observable coordinates.
This fixture is not an EGB physical calculation and must never be presented as one.
An invertible basis change must preserve the covariance-aware Mahalanobis score when both the mean difference and covariance are transported.
Unit rescaling must preserve the score when the mean difference and covariance are transformed consistently.
claim_ceiling: This control checks covariance-aware linear algebra and invariance to an algebraically redundant observable. It does not validate #8034, a probability model, an EGB response, an experimental design, or SOTA performance.

invertible_basis_transport.description: Exact nonsingular change of observable basis. Difference mean and covariance are transported together.

unit_rescaling.description: Exact unit rescaling x1' = 1000*x1 and x2' = x2/100. The mean and covariance must use the same unit transform.
